retrievalProfile.description: A centered oval halftone portrait set against a textured, muted background with stacked slab-serif typography above and below.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring a central vertical oval containing a high-contrast, sepia-toned halftone portrait. The oval is bordered by a thick cream-colored frame and set against a desaturated, textured mauve-beige background. Typography is vertically stacked and centered, using condensed slab-serifs with thin outlines.
coreVisualRelationships: Central oval anchor with vertical symmetry
High-contrast halftone texture against smooth background
Muted earth tones contrasting with thin red and blue type outlines
Stacked text balancing the top and bottom of the frame
coreInvariants: Halftone grain in the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a head-and-shoulders portrait contained within a central oval, occupying approximately 40% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central oval frame acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow from the upper text, through the central portrait, to the lower text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous margins on the left and right sides create a sense of formal isolation.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and dusty blue for typographic outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast within the halftone portrait.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and desaturated pastels

characterSpecificRedesigns: Thin colored outlines around white or transparent fills
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family with varying outline colors and weights.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky slab-serif structure and condensed width.
Captures the vintage wood-type feel often used in 70s folk aesthetics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a matte, textured mauve-beige background. In the center, place a vertical cream-colored oval frame. Inside the frame, place a high-contrast sepia-toned halftone portrait of a person with a beard and a hat.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of centered, stacked uppercase text using a condensed slab-serif font. The top block should have a thin red outline; the bottom block should have a thin blue outline.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait contained within a clean oval frame?
Is the halftone texture visible in the portrait?
Are the text blocks centered and stacked vertically?
Is the color palette muted and desaturated?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos or catalog numbers
Specific song titles or artist names
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the halftone effect doesn't obscure the subject's form.
Verify the paper texture is consistent across the background.
Check that the text outlines are thin and crisp.
Confirm the oval is perfectly centered horizontally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central oval halftone + stacked slab-serif type + muted textured background.
